title: Business Central AL Customization Project
desc:
My priority is to build and refine Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central through new AL objects, with the spotlight on custom tables and pages. These pages must support clean data entry, run their own validation, trigger custom workflows, and surface key metrics in dashboard-style reports.  

Beyond the UI layer, I need business logic that enforces bespoke validation rules and handles data integration processes so information moves reliably between internal modules and any external systems we connect later.  

Additional work will include, when required, adjusting RDLC or Word layouts for reports, extending posting and approval workflows, exposing data through APIs or web services, and tuning SQL for performance.  

Deliverables  
• AL code for tables, pages, and supporting codeunits  
• Implemented validation rules and workflow logic, fully tested  
• Dashboard/report layouts and any modified RDLC/Word files  
• Technical documentation (object list, install steps, test scripts)  
• Source packaged in a Git repository and a compiled extension ready for deployment  

Acceptance Criteria  
• Extension installs without compile warnings or permission errors  
• All test scenarios for data entry, validation, and workflow pass  
• Performance meets current production benchmarks  
• Documentation is clear enough for another developer to maintain  

I will provide functional specs and a sandbox; you return weekly progress updates and commit to the agreed timeline and quality gates.

title: AI Cattle Collar Development
desc:
I need a working prototype of an AI-enabled collar that keeps real-time watch over a cow’s well-being and daily habits. The collar has to:

• Track health by continuously capturing heart rate, temperature and respiration, flagging anomalies for early intervention.  
• Record activity patterns—grazing time, walking distance and rest periods—so I can optimise feed plans and pasture rotation.

I am open to your recommended sensor suite, low-power electronics, edge AI models and a simple companion app or dashboard that turns raw readings into clear, actionable insights. Deliver a fully assembled collar with firmware, data pipeline and a short demo showing the metrics streaming accurately from a live test or simulator.  

If you have previous experience in livestock wearables, embedded ML (TensorFlow Lite, Edge Impulse or similar) and rugged hardware design, I’d like to see it and discuss the timeline to first field trials.

title: Organic Makhana Seasoning Blend
desc:
I need a reliable partner to develop and scale an herbs-and-spices seasoning specifically for makhana snack flavoring. The blend must rely solely on natural, organic ingredients—no synthetics, artificial colors, or anti-caking agents. I already have a taste direction in mind (lightly earthy with a gentle kick), but I am open to your suggestions for achieving a standout profile that will keep consumers reaching for the next handful.

What I expect from you:
• A finished formulation with exact percentages and processing instructions  
• Guidance on sourcing certified-organic raw materials and possible alternate suppliers for cost control  
• A small pilot batch (1–2 kg) for sensory and shelf-life testing  
• Documentation on regulatory compliance and nutritional data suitable for export packaging  
• Clear scale-up notes so the recipe can move straight into commercial production

Experience with snack-food seasonings, spice milling, and organic certification will be valued highly. If you can demonstrate previous results with clean-label products or have access to extrusion/coating equipment for test runs, please mention it in your proposal along with an estimated timeline to first samples.

title: Grow Telegram via Instagram Ads
desc:
I run a Telegram channel for traders and want to fill it with genuinely interested subscribers—not bots or vague “finance” traffic, but people who actively follow trading content. To do this I need a specialist who can plan, launch, and optimise Instagram Explore ads.

You’ll handle the full campaign inside Meta Ads Manager: research the most responsive trading-focused interests, craft creative that speaks to that niche, set up a clear funnel straight to my Telegram link, and keep a close eye on performance so spend translates into quality joins. Story or Feed placements can remain off for now; the push is squarely on Explore where discovery is highest for new audiences.

Please ensure all conversions are real humans. I’ll monitor engagement stats on the channel and will pause the project immediately if artificial traffic appears.

Deliverables:
• Live Explore-placement campaign targeting trading enthusiasts  
• Compelling image or short-form video ads plus copy  
• Daily optimisation and budget pacing  
• Weekly report summarising spend, CPM, CTR, cost-per-join, and overall subscriber growth

Share a quick outline of your approach, any similar Telegram growth results, and the timeframe you expect before the first noticeable bump in subscribers. Let’s drive serious traders into the channel together.

title: Nifty50 Minute OHLC Data -- 2
desc:
I need a clean, gap-free OHLC data set for the Nifty 50 index on a 1-minute timeframe covering 1 January 2020 right up to the end of the current trading day. I will supply an Excel template that already lists every required timestamp; simply populate the Open, High, Low and Close columns against each row.

Key points  
• Source must be Zerodha only (Kite historical API or another Zerodha-backed feed).  
• No extra fields are necessary—just the four price columns.  
• Final delivery should be the same workbook returned to me in .xlsx format, ready for immediate use.

Before we wrap up, I’ll verify the file for missing intervals, incorrect time zones (IST), or obvious outliers. Once everything checks out, the job is complete.

title: Data Cleanup & Web Verification
desc:

Once the sheet is tidy, every contact detail—name, phone, email, and address—has to be cross-checked against reliable web sources to make sure the data is accurate and up to date.  

When the verification step is done, the final workbook must follow my formatting guidelines (column order, header style, conditional colour coding). I will share a short style guide and a small sample so you can mirror the look and feel exactly.

Deliverables  
• Cleaned and consolidated customer-info spreadsheet  
• Column-by-column log of any corrections made, including URLs or screenshots that confirm each updated contact detail  
• Final file delivered in Excel and Google Sheets formats, formatted to the provided guidelines  

A sharp eye, solid command of Excel formulas and data-validation tools, plus clear, timely communication are must-haves. If that sounds like you, let’s get started right away.

title: Recover Deleted Camera video
desc:
I pulled a 64 GB SanDisk Ultra microSDXC card from my security camera as soon as I realised the clip I need—recordings from 3 August—had disappeared. Roughly 53 GB of the card was filled when I removed it; the camera routinely overwrites anything older than two days, so at present I can still see 7 and 8 August files, and even some fragments from 6 August when I run Restore My Files. Nothing newer has been written since the card came out of the camera, and there have been no error messages during any attempt so far. Other than Restore My Files, no additional recovery tools have touched the card.

What I need now is an experienced data-recovery specialist who has successfully brought back video from microSD cards used in cameras. The goal is simple: retrieve every playable file from 3 August before any latent data is lost for good.

Deliverable  
• Playable video files (original resolution/format) shot on 3 August.

When you reply, please tell me:  
– Your closest comparable recovery jobs and outcomes.  
– Your estimated probability of success for this case.  
– Your fee structure for both the initial examination and the full recovery.  
– How soon you can start and how long the process is likely to take.

The card is ready to be shipped or imaged as you prefer, and I’ll follow any handling instructions you provide to maximise the chances of full recovery.

title: Accurate Scanned Document Typing
desc:
I will supply a series of scanned images that must be re-typed into clean, editable files. The pages include plenty of numbers as well as text, so precision is critical—every figure has to match the source exactly. A steady typing speed of 35–60 wpm is fine as long as accuracy stays high throughout.  

Microsoft Word and, where tables or calculations appear, Microsoft Excel should be used so the final files mirror the original layout and can be searched, edited, and archived easily.  

Deliverables  
• One properly formatted Word or Excel file for each scanned page  
• Correct spelling, punctuation, and—most importantly—error-free numerical data  
• File names that follow the original document order for straightforward cross-checking  

I will review the work by comparing it against the scans; any discrepancies in numbers or omitted content will need correction before final approval.

title: B2B Telesales Lead Generation
desc:
I need an experienced telesales professional who can pick up the phone, speak confidently with businesses in my chosen regions, and turn cold prospects into warm leads for our digital-marketing and affiliate solutions. The single focus is drumming up new business; every call you place should aim to book a discovery meeting or secure a clear next step with a decision-maker.

You will receive:  
• A concise brief on our services (SEO, email marketing, social media management, affiliate sign-ups, and more).  
• A target list of companies, including contact names where available.  
• Access to our cloud CRM for logging outcomes.

What I expect from you:  
• Professional, consultative calling that positions us as a partner, not a pushy salesperson.  
• Daily report of dials, conversations, and scheduled follow-ups.  
• Insightful feedback on objections you encounter so we can fine-tune the pitch.  
• Accurate data entry in the CRM; no loose spreadsheets or missed notes.  

Acceptance criteria  
1. Minimum agreed call volume reached each day.  
2. All call outcomes recorded with next action.  
3. A weekly summary highlighting number of new leads, appointments set, and any trending objections.

If you’re persuasive on the phone, comfortable talking to business owners and marketing managers, and disciplined with CRM notes, let’s talk.

title: Recover 3 Aug & Nearby Recordings
desc:
My security unit overwrites footage after two days, yet I still see traces of 6 August files when I scan the disk (57 GB capacity, 53 GB in use) with “Restore My Files.” This tells me the data from 3 August—and hopefully the neighbouring days—is still lingering in unallocated space.

I need those 3 August recordings brought back and saved directly onto the same device in their original MP4 format. If you can rescue anything just before or after that date as well, even better, but the 3 August material is the priority.

You will have remote or on-site access to the drive image, whichever is safer for data integrity, and I’m happy to create a sector-by-sector clone if you instruct me. Please outline the recovery workflow you intend to follow, the tools you trust (e.g., R-Studio, PhotoRec, GetDataBack, or your own custom scripts), and how you will verify file completeness before handing them over.

Successful delivery means:
• MP4 files from 3 August restored and playable on the device.  
• Any additional footage you can salvage from the surrounding dates placed in a separate folder.  
• A short note on what was recoverable and any sectors that proved unrecoverable.

Let me know your estimated turnaround and any preparatory steps you need from my side.

title: SolidWorks 2D Manufacturing Drawings
desc:
I have a steady stream of mechanical work that revolves around producing clear, fully-dimensioned 2D drawings in SolidWorks and, quite often, reverse-engineering existing parts. Everything is still at the concept-design stage, so I rely on precise drawings to validate form, fit, and function before committing to tooling.

Here is what I need from you on an ongoing basis:  

• Translate my hand sketches, photos, or sample components into SolidWorks parts and assemblies, then generate manufacturing-ready SLDDRW files (plus PDF/DXF exports).  
• Reverse-engineer physical parts when all I can supply is reference geometry or measurements, preserving design intent and critical tolerances.

• Iterate quickly when I provide mark-ups, keeping version control tidy inside the SolidWorks file set.

Acceptance criteria for each task are straightforward: the drawing must open without errors in SolidWorks 2022 or later, dimensions must tie back to the model, and the output PDF/DXF should print at 1:1 with a clear title block and revision table.

If you are comfortable working this way and can turn small batches around within a few days, let’s get started—I have the first component ready for you as soon as you’re onboard.

- Comfortable speaking with business owners across various industries.

title: Plans 2D pour permis
desc:

title: AI Reels & Shorts Production -- 2
desc:
I am looking for a skilled creator who can turn my concepts into eye-catching, AI-generated videos for Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts. Each clip will centre on product reviews and must feel polished, concise, and unmistakably professional from the first second to the last.

I will hand over the raw idea, key talking points, and any product assets. Your job is to choose the right AI tools—whether that is Runway, Synthesia, Midjourney, or your own mix—then script, generate, edit, and deliver scroll-stopping 9:16 videos that meet current platform specs. Clean motion graphics, snappy captions, royalty-free audio, and colour-corrected footage are all expected so the final export is ready to upload without extra tweaks on my end.

Because experience matters to me, please lead your bid with examples of short-form work you have already produced in a similar product-review style. A quick note on your workflow, toolset, typical turnaround, and rate structure will help me gauge fit and plan upcoming batches.

Deliverables for each video:
• A 15-60-second vertical video (1080×1920 or 4K) in .mp4  
• SRT or burned-in captions that match spoken content  
• A high-resolution cover thumbnail (1280×720)  

I will review submissions as they come in and reach out to creators whose past experience aligns with the professional tone and quality I’m after. I’m ready to get started as soon as I find the right partner.

title: Daily Amazon Scraping Automation
desc:
I need a robust, fully automated process that pulls three specific data sets from Amazon every single day:

• Product details (titles, bullet points, specs, ASIN, images)  
• Customer reviews with ratings and timestamps  
• Current pricing, including promotions and historical price if visible  

The solution should run on a schedule without manual intervention, gracefully handle captchas or page-layout changes, and drop the results into a clean, structured file or database table I can query—CSV or JSON is fine. Accuracy and consistency matter more than sheer speed; if a product page fails on one run, the script should log the error and retry.

I’m comfortable working with Python, so Scrapy, Requests/BeautifulSoup, or Selenium are all acceptable. If you prefer another stack that achieves the same reliability, let me know. Please include in your bid:

• A brief outline of your approach to avoiding Amazon’s anti-bot measures  
• Sample output for one ASIN so I can confirm the field structure  
• Estimated turnaround to get the first successful daily run in place  

Once everything is stable, I’ll test the feed against my downstream pipeline before signing off.

title: Modern Product Showcase Brochure Design
desc:
I have an expanding catalogue of products and need a talented designer to create our very first set of printed brochures. These brochures must feel modern and clean while clearly showcasing each item’s key features, technical specs, and benefits.  

You will be working with existing logos, colour palettes, and product photos; however, I’m open to subtle refinements that strengthen overall brand consistency. Once the brochure template is perfected, the same visual language will roll out to warranty cards, user manuals, dealer price lists, technical sheets, scheme flyers, and other collateral, so I’m keen on building an ongoing collaboration.  

Deliverables for this initial phase:  
• Print-ready brochure (press-quality PDF)  
• Editable source file (cdr, psd, etc)  
• Web-optimised PDF for email and download  

Acceptance criteria: the final layout must follow the approved colour palette and typography, flow logically from cover to back page, and reproduce accurately on both digital and offset presses. If you have experience translating brochure styles into manuals or tech sheets later on, be sure to mention it—I intend for this project to be the cornerstone of a full brand toolkit.

title: Corporate GenAI App UI Design
desc:
I already have the GenAI engine running smoothly—what’s missing is a clean, corporate-grade face for it. I need a designer who can craft a professional frontend that feels trustworthy and executive while still being fresh.  

The palette is set: crisp greens on white, with enough contrast to keep accessibility tight. Within that frame, the interface must highlight three focal points:  
• User input forms that are streamlined, intuitive, and easy on the eye  
• Data-rich visualizations that translate AI output into clear, decision-ready graphics  
• Interactive buttons with subtle feedback that keep the experience engaging without looking playful  

I’ll share the application flow and branding assets once we start; you’ll return high-fidelity screens plus the accompanying component library (Figma or equivalent) ready for hand-off to my dev team. Responsive behaviour for standard desktop and mobile breakpoints should be covered so implementation is painless on our side.  

If this sounds like your wheelhouse, let’s align and get the UI locked in and budget is around 5K

title: Penulis Deskripsi Produk Fashion
desc:
Saya sedang mencari penulis kreatif berbahasa Indonesia yang terbiasa meracik deskripsi produk untuk kategori fashion dan aksesoris. Tugas Anda adalah mengubah detail teknis—seperti bahan, ukuran, dan fitur unik—menjadi teks singkat yang menarik, informatif, dan mendorong pembelian di toko online saya.

Apa yang saya butuhkan:
• Deskripsi produk orisinal dengan nada brand-friendly, tidak terkesan menyalin pabrik.
• Fokus pada fashion & aksesoris: pakaian, tas, sepatu, perhiasan, hingga item pelengkap gaya.
• Setiap deskripsi harus mencakup poin manfaat, bahan/komposisi, dan ajakan bertindak singkat.
• Optimasi kata kunci dasar agar mudah ditemukan di marketplace maupun Google.

Proses kerja:
1. Saya kirimkan daftar produk serta spesifikasi singkatnya.
2. Anda menulis draf deskripsi sesuai gaya yang disepakati.
3. Revisi ringan bila diperlukan sampai konten siap tayang.

Jika Anda pernah menulis untuk merek fashion, marketplace, atau e-commerce, sertakan contoh portofolio relevan. Saya menghargai penulis yang sigap, komunikatif, dan mampu menjaga konsistensi tone di seluruh katalog.

title: Children’s Literacy Curriculum Creation
desc:
I’m developing “Evana10@#K,” an educational initiative for children that nurtures early Language and Literacy skills. I need a creative partner who can help me turn core reading and writing objectives into engaging, age-appropriate learning materials.  

The scope includes crafting short lessons, playful exercises, and simple assessments that spark curiosity while reinforcing phonics, vocabulary, and basic comprehension. If you’re comfortable blending storytelling, visuals, and interactive elements—whether worksheets, slide decks, or brief videos—we’ll be a great fit.  

Deliverables I’d like to see:  
• A sequenced mini-curriculum (about 6–8 lessons) with clear learning goals  
• Printable or digital activity sheets for each lesson  
• A concise teacher/parent guide explaining how to use the materials and track progress  

Please share a sample or short outline of how you’d approach one lesson so I can gauge your style. I’m ready to start as soon as we agree on the format and timeline.

title: Boost Organic Politics & Law Channel Engagement
desc:
I run a fast-growing channel that focuses on law and politics and publish mainly video content on both YouTube and Instagram. My immediate goal is to raise reach, attract new followers, and deepen genuine interaction on each platform at the same pace, without paid ads or artificial boosts.

The work begins with an audit of my current profiles, followed by a practical roadmap that covers keyword and hashtag strategy, thumbnail and caption improvements, posting cadence, and audience targeting specific to legal and political topics. Solid knowledge of YouTube Studio, Instagram Insights, Shorts/Reels formatting, and community-building tactics is essential. Experience—especially with channels in comparable niches—will weigh heavily in my selection, so be sure to highlight previous successes.

Deliverables I will review each week:  
• A short performance dashboard showing growth in views, watch time, followers, and engagement rates on both platforms  
• An action list of optimization steps completed and the next items queued  
• Three to five content or format suggestions rooted in the data gathered

Success is defined by steady, sustainable upticks in organic impressions, follower count, and meaningful comments that show viewers are engaging with the legal and political angles of my videos.

title: SolidWorks Micro Skiff Design -- 3
desc:
I’m putting together a compact aluminum micro skiff and need a SolidWorks expert to transform my concept sketches into a fully detailed, build-ready model. The end result should let a fabricator jump straight to cutting and welding without guesswork.

Scope:  
- Build a complete parametric 3D model of the hull and structure in SolidWorks, showing every aluminum frame, stringer, and plate.  
- Flesh out the interior: seating layout, dedicated storage lockers, and a small console with a dashboard. All hinging lids, cut-outs, and access hatches must be present so clearances are obvious.  
- Keep the construction in aluminum throughout; no plywood or mixed materials.

Deliverables:  
- Native SolidWorks assembly and part files (.SLDASM / .SLDPRT) with clean feature trees.  
- Flattened DXF files for every sheet-metal plate, ready for CNC cutting (correct material thickness included).  
- A brief PDF or marked-up drawing set highlighting bend lines, weld locations, and overall dimensions.

Acceptance Criteria:  
The model must rebuild without errors, every DXF must unfold flat at 1:1 scale, and mating of parts in the assembly must be interference-free.

If you’ve designed welded aluminum boats before, please mention it and feel free to share screenshots or renders.

title: Re-type Scanned PDF Manuscript
desc:
I have a scanned PDF manuscript of roughly 51 – 100 pages that needs to be turned into an editable digital document. The scan is clear and mostly printed text; only a handful of pages include short handwritten annotations that I still need captured—either reproduced verbatim in brackets or clearly flagged so I can review them later.

The job is straightforward: faithfully type everything exactly as it appears, keep the original section breaks, headings, and any basic formatting, and supply the finished file in Microsoft Word (DOCX). If you prefer to run an OCR pass first, that is fine, but please proofread so the final copy is error-free and consistent throughout.

Acceptance criteria  
• Complete Word file matching the source content and layout  
• All handwritten notes transcribed and distinguishable (e.g., [handwritten])  
• Spelling, punctuation, and paragraphing double-checked for accuracy  

Once delivered, I will perform a quick spot check across several pages; if everything aligns, we are done.

title: Power Supply Schematic Cleanup & PCB Design In Orcad
desc:
Power Supply (BS1001) — OrCAD Schematic Cleanup & PCB Layout

We need the schematic for our 8A power supply board (BS1001, OrCAD Capture, 5 sheets: Top Level, AC Power, AC/DC Converter, Charger/Boost, Controller) fully cleaned up and then laid out as a PCB.

Background: This is a continuation of design work already done in-house. The schematic exists and is functional, but needs a DRC cleanup pass (illegal characters in footprint properties, missing pin numbers on several component types, one missing footprint) before it's ready for layout. We've already worked with a freelancer informally on an initial cleanup pass with good results — this project formalizes the remaining work with clear milestones.

Milestone 1 — £150
- Full DRC cleanup across all 5 schematic sheets: zero illegal-character footprint properties, zero missing pin numbers, zero missing footprints
- Deliverables: the cleaned .dsn, a fresh DRC report run against that exact file, and a complete BOM (refdes/qty/category/description/value/package/manufacturer/MPN) generated from that same final schematic — not an earlier version

- Full PCB layout per our written PCB spec: 3-zone isolation (Dirty/Clean/Super Clean), defined clearance rules around the isolation barrier, EMI-critical component placement, fusing

- Deliverables: Gerbers

title: Weekly Task Scheduler Desktop App
desc:
I need a straightforward desktop program whose single purpose is to let me schedule and visualise my week. The emphasis is on task scheduling only—no time-tracking dashboards or reminder pop-ups at this stage—so the interface can stay clean and focused.

Core flow  
• Open the app to a Monday-to-Sunday grid  
• Add, edit or delete tasks and instantly see them slotted into their chosen day and time block  
• Save everything to a lightweight local file or embedded database so my plans persist after closing the program  

Tech preferences  
I am on Windows, but if you can deliver a cross-platform build through Electron, .NET MAUI, Qt, or a similarly stable framework, that works for me as well. Feel free to propose what you think suits the scope best.

Acceptance criteria  
1. Installer or portable executable that launches without extra dependencies.  
2. Intuitive weekly view with drag-and-drop or quick edit controls.  
3. Data is stored locally and reloads accurately on start-up.  
4. Clean, responsive UI—nothing fancy, but no visual glitches.  
5. Source code and brief build instructions supplied on delivery.

That is all I need for version one; additional features like time tracking or reminder alerts can wait for a later phase.

title: Copywriting for Tourist Destination
desc:
I’m preparing a piece that showcases a specific tourist destination and I only need the writing itself—no design, layout, or imagery. The goal is to produce vivid, persuasive copy that makes readers feel the place, picture themselves there, and ultimately want to book a trip.

You’ll be handling descriptive copy writing focused on a place, so please lean into sensory detail, local color, and clear calls-to-action that suit travel-minded readers. Think engaging storytelling rather than a dry fact sheet; I’m looking for energy, warmth, and accurate information blended into a seamless narrative.

Deliverables  
• One polished copy-writing piece about the destination (roughly 700–900 words, but I’m flexible if you see a better length).  
• A brief headline plus sub-head suggestions that match the tone.  
• Final text supplied in an editable Google Doc or Word file.

Acceptance criteria  
– Copy is 100 % original, proof-read, and free of fluff.  
– Tone is inviting and descriptive, with concrete details that highlight what sets the spot apart.  
– Includes a natural call-to-action that fits the intended traveler audience.  
– Delivered on or before the agreed deadline.

If you have travel-writing samples, share a link so I can gauge style alignment. Looking forward to seeing how you bring this destination to life.
